app/stagelab/page.tsx:20	Who is StageLab built for?
app/stagelab/page.tsx:21	StageLab is for physique athletes preparing for competition and coaches who review athlete check-ins, prep plans, and progress trends.
app/stagelab/page.tsx:24	Does StageLab replace a contest prep coach?
app/stagelab/page.tsx:25	No. StageLab organizes data and provides AI-assisted informational outputs, but athletes remain responsible for their decisions and should seek qualified professional guidance when appropriate.
app/stagelab/page.tsx:28	What can I track during prep?
app/stagelab/page.tsx:29	StageLab supports weekly check-ins, bodyweight and progress trends, physique photos, calories and macros, cardio, steps, recovery markers, and prep-plan changes.
app/stagelab/page.tsx:32	Are StageLab recommendations guaranteed to be accurate?
app/stagelab/page.tsx:33	No. Recommendations and visual analysis may be incomplete or inaccurate. They are designed to support review and planning, not guarantee stage readiness, health outcomes, or competition results.
app/stagelab/page.tsx:36	Where can I download StageLab?
app/stagelab/page.tsx:37	StageLab is available on the Apple App Store and Google Play for supported iOS and Android devices.
